convert_audio_to_16k: convert all audio files in a directory to 16kHz mono wav format using sox
convert_stereo_audio_to_16k: convert stereo audio files in a directory to 16kHz wav format preserving stereo channels
find_audio_files_by_extension: find all audio files with a specific extension recursively in a directory tree
convert_single_audio_file: convert a single audio file to 16kHz wav format using the sox command line tool
batch_convert_with_overwrite: batch convert audio files to 16kHz wav with an option to overwrite existing output files
